item.title: So, We Moved In
item.description: After years of building, many Bunnings trips and an unreasonable amount of sanding, we finally moved into the Miette in February. It is now October. So, what have we been doing for the last eight months? Well, apparently the building never really stops. First two minute noodles in the tiny house Close up of our noodles, feels like every new place needs a memorable first meal In an attempt to summarise, what has been a year since we last wrote, strap in for a whistle tour of highlights.

item.title: Oct Build Update
item.description: An October build update We got solar! ☀️ ☀️ ☀️ Table Of Contents What we’ve done Highlights Challenges What’s next? What we’ve done One of our neighbours decided to demolish their house without removing their 10 year old solar system (it was not cost effective for them to re-install). Luckily for us they said that if we could take it down we could have it! Erny clambered onto the roof on a balmy Sunday day to bring the panels down.
